dct_description_sm: Percent vegetation cover (PVC) estimates, including species identification and height, were measured along transect throughout for the Apex River Watershed (ARW), Iqaluit, Nunavut, over the growing season. PVC was collected in as per the International Tundra Experiment (ITEX) protocols and is currently the most recent vegetation assessment of the ARW. These data will allow us to determine the overall PVC for each plant community in the entire watershed by testing the relationship between PVC and satellite derived Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI).
dct_title_s: 2015 ITEX Percent Vegetation Cover, Apex River Watershed, Iqaluit, Nunavut
